title: Readiness reasons as coded findings with a fix and a door on the System strip
deviations_from_card: (1) Added one route-level case to app/api/health/health-exposure.test.ts (findings absent for anonymous and org-b, present for home org; origin fallback is a warn finding, not a reason; status code unmoved). (2) readinessFindings.ts decides 'known code' by asking the catalog (t.has, injected as `knows`) rather than importing READINESS_CODES, because readiness.ts value-imports the DB layer and must not enter the client bundle; the import is type-only. The bijection test imports READINESS_CODES server-side. (3) Findings are built through a finding() constructor, not `code: "X"` literals: i18n:check sweeps inline `code:` literals as API error codes and demanded errors.<CODE> entries; readiness codes resolve under models.system.findings instead. (4) Severity is presentation only: SCHEDULER_STARTING is a warn but still gates the probe (it always did); PUBLIC_ORIGIN_CONFLICT/FALLBACK are the only probe-exempt codes, so /api/ops ok still includes the origin (parity). (5) Host remedy maps to action 'none' on the client; the fix text says restart/repair. (6) perf-budget.json app/page.tsx raised 1389/8716 -> 1390/8723 (readinessFindings.ts +1 module, ~6 KB).
notes: tsc exit 2 is only the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (foreign); zero errors in app/. test:perf red only on the pre-existing job-ingest.ts 402/400 line. Full test:unit 9915/9915 green. New catalog keys: models.system.findingEnv, findingsLabel, findings.<7 codes>.{title,fix} in en/cs/de/fr. /api/health public verdict unchanged; findings ride hostDetail (requireHomeOrgReader tier from slot A); deployment-read-gate.test.ts green. Not visually verified in a browser (no dev server touched).
